title: Outbound HTTPS SSRF boundary under DNS and redirect rebinding

turns.prompt: An outbound URL checker still reached a cloud metadata address after following a redirect. Read README.md, reproduce the failure, identify the end-to-end cause, and propose the smallest fix. Do not edit files yet.

Security confirmed additional rules: accept only absolute HTTPS without credentials/fragments; normalize IDNA hosts and a trailing dot; resolve every hop exactly once and reject the whole answer if any IPv4, IPv6, mapped, or zone-scoped address is not global; pin an approved numeric IP while preserving Host/SNI; validate redirects before their network call, with relative resolution, exact Location grammar, loop and hop bounds; strip Authorization/Cookie across origins; never consume redirect bodies; validate response headers and conflicting Content-Length; and enforce the body limit incrementally without reading a later chunk. Revise the plan and explicitly invalidate first-address-only checks, hostname transport, initial-hop-only validation, string-prefix address filters, unlimited buffering, redirect-body reads, or credential forwarding.
Approved: implement the smallest complete product fix, add deterministic regression tests if needed, run the complete public suite, and preserve operator_note.txt and all existing test authority.
